name: Ethane
description: Two carbon atoms joined by a single bond; each carbon has three hydrogens.

name: Ethene
description: Two carbon atoms joined by a double bond; each carbon has two hydrogens.

name: Ethanol
description: A two-carbon chain with a terminal OH group, CH3CH2OH.

name: Ethanal
description: CH3 joined to a carbon bearing one hydrogen and a double bond to oxygen, CH3CHO.

name: Ethanoic acid
description: CH3 joined to a carboxyl group: one C=O bond and one C–OH bond, CH3COOH.
